title: On-Average KL-Privacy and its equivalence to Generalization for Max-Entropy Mechanisms
review_status: full-text section audit complete; theoretical result plus illustrative simulations
sections_checked: definition and comparison to worst-case differential privacy
two simulation examples and empirical limitations
venue_year_verified: Privacy in Statistical Databases (2016), pp. 121-134; arXiv v1 submitted 2016-05-08.
evidence_note: Defines distribution-specific expected privacy loss and proves connections/equivalence to on-average generalization for a class of Gibbs mechanisms. Two simple simulations illustrate estimates; no real-data/deployment privacy attack or distribution-shift validation. Average-case notion does not imply worst-case DP protection.

title: IoTGaze: IoT Security Enforcement via Wireless Context Analysis
review_status: full-text section audit complete; bounded SmartThings/ZigBee proof-of-concept
sections_checked: injected anomaly precision/recall tables and failure cases
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 submitted 2020-06-29; paper states to appear IEEE INFOCOM 2020.
evidence_note: Five device types, 19 event types; event-identification accuracy 98.46% in the stated office testbed. For three manually injected threat types (100 instances per app/type), precision 97.22/98.55/98.29% and recall 94.82/98.36/95.20%. The separate 183-app scan generates candidate hidden-channel chains, not 183 validated exploits. Narrow platform/protocol and injected-anomaly scope.
